---
title: "Isochrones"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Google Maps Platform recently launched an [Isochrones API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/isochrones/overview) (currently in preview) that draws the area reachable within a given travel time along the real road/path network, rather than a simple "as the crow flies" radius. Below are isochrones from two addresses: 310 Young St, Annandale NSW (Sydney) and 34 Herrick St, Mount Gravatt QLD (Brisbane). The API is time-based rather than distance-based, so both maps show travel-*time* isochrones.

This page calls the Isochrones API directly from your browser, so it needs a Google Maps Platform API key with the **Maps JavaScript API**, **Geocoding API**, and **Isochrones API** enabled (and billing set up — the Isochrones API is a paid preview product). Your key is stored only in this browser's `localStorage` and is sent straight from your browser to Google; it never touches any server of mine.

```{=html}
<div class="iso-app">

  <div class="iso-key-panel" id="isoKeyPanel">
    <label for="isoApiKey">Google Maps Platform API key</label>
    <input type="password" id="isoApiKey" placeholder="AIza..." autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
    <label class="iso-key-check">
      <input type="checkbox" id="isoKeyShow"> show
    </label>
    <button class="iso-btn-primary" id="isoKeyLoad">Load maps</button>
    <button class="iso-btn-secondary" id="isoKeyClear">Clear saved key</button>
    <div class="iso-key-status" id="isoKeyStatus">Enter a key and click "Load maps" to draw the isochrones below. Nothing loads until you do.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="iso-grid" id="isoGrid"></div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var STORAGE_KEY = "isochrones_gmp_api_key_v1";

  var LOCATIONS = [
    {
      id: "syd",
      label: "Annandale, Sydney",
      address: "310 Young St, Annandale NSW 2038, Australia",
      color: "#2a6f6f"
    },
    {
      id: "bne",
      label: "Mount Gravatt, Brisbane",
      address: "34 Herrick St, Mount Gravatt QLD 4122, Australia",
      color: "#c1622d"
    }
  ];

  var MODE_MAX_SECONDS = {
    DRIVE: 3600,
    WALK: 7200,
    BICYCLE: 7200
  };

  var DURATION_OPTIONS_MIN = {
    DRIVE: [10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60],
    WALK: [10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120],
    BICYCLE: [10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120]
  };

  var grid = document.getElementById("isoGrid");
  var keyInput = document.getElementById("isoApiKey");
  var keyShow = document.getElementById("isoKeyShow");
  var keyLoadBtn = document.getElementById("isoKeyLoad");
  var keyClearBtn = document.getElementById("isoKeyClear");
  var keyStatus = document.getElementById("isoKeyStatus");

  var panels = {};

  function setKeyStatus(msg, kind) {
    keyStatus.textContent = msg;
    keyStatus.className = "iso-key-status" + (kind ? " iso-" + kind : "");
  }

  function buildPanels() {
    LOCATIONS.forEach(function (loc) {
      var panel = document.createElement("div");
      panel.className = "iso-panel";
      panel.innerHTML =
        '<div class="iso-panel-header">' +
        '  <div class="iso-panel-title"><span class="iso-swatch" style="background:' + loc.color + '"></span>' + loc.label + '</div>' +
        '  <div class="iso-panel-address">' + loc.address + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="iso-controls">' +
        '  <select class="iso-mode" data-loc="' + loc.id + '">' +
        '    <option value="DRIVE">Drive</option>' +
        '    <option value="WALK">Walk</option>' +
        '    <option value="BICYCLE">Bicycle</option>' +
        '  </select>' +
        '  <select class="iso-duration" data-loc="' + loc.id + '"></select>' +
        '  <select class="iso-direction" data-loc="' + loc.id + '">' +
        '    <option value="FROM">From here</option>' +
        '    <option value="TO">To here</option>' +
        '  </select>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="iso-map" id="isoMap-' + loc.id + '">Enter your API key above and click "Load maps".</div>' +
        '<div class="iso-panel-status" id="isoStatus-' + loc.id + '"></div>';
      grid.appendChild(panel);

      panels[loc.id] = {
        loc: loc,
        mapEl: panel.querySelector("#isoMap-" + loc.id),
        statusEl: panel.querySelector("#isoStatus-" + loc.id),
        modeSel: panel.querySelector(".iso-mode"),
        durationSel: panel.querySelector(".iso-duration"),
        directionSel: panel.querySelector(".iso-direction"),
        map: null,
        marker: null,
        dataLayer: null,
        location: null
      };

      populateDurationOptions(panels[loc.id]);

      panels[loc.id].modeSel.addEventListener("change", function () {
        populateDurationOptions(panels[loc.id]);
        runIsochrone(panels[loc.id]);
      });
      panels[loc.id].durationSel.addEventListener("change", function () {
        runIsochrone(panels[loc.id]);
      });
      panels[loc.id].directionSel.addEventListener("change", function () {
        runIsochrone(panels[loc.id]);
      });
    });
  }

  function populateDurationOptions(panel) {
    var mode = panel.modeSel.value;
    var mins = DURATION_OPTIONS_MIN[mode];
    var prev = panel.durationSel.value;
    panel.durationSel.innerHTML = mins.map(function (m) {
      return '<option value="' + (m * 60) + '">' + m + ' min</option>';
    }).join("");
    if (prev && mins.some(function (m) { return String(m * 60) === prev; })) {
      panel.durationSel.value = prev;
    } else {
      panel.durationSel.value = String(mins[1] * 60); // second option as a sane default
    }
  }

  function setPanelStatus(panel, msg, isError) {
    panel.statusEl.textContent = msg || "";
    panel.statusEl.className = "iso-panel-status" + (isError ? " iso-error" : "");
  }

  function getApiKey() {
    return keyInput.value.trim();
  }

  function loadGoogleMaps(key) {
    setKeyStatus("Loading Google Maps…");
    keyLoadBtn.disabled = true;

    var existing = document.getElementById("isoGoogleMapsScript");
    if (existing) existing.remove();

    window.__isoInit = function () {
      setKeyStatus("Google Maps loaded. Geocoding addresses…", "ok");
      keyLoadBtn.disabled = false;
      initLocations(key);
    };

    var script = document.createElement("script");
    script.id = "isoGoogleMapsScript";
    script.async = true;
    script.defer = true;
    script.src = "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=" + encodeURIComponent(key) + "&callback=__isoInit&v=weekly";
    script.onerror = function () {
      keyLoadBtn.disabled = false;
      setKeyStatus(
        "Failed to load the Google Maps script. If you're viewing this inside a sandboxed preview (e.g. an embedded artifact), open the page directly in a normal browser tab instead — sandboxed previews block external scripts.",
        "error"
      );
    };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  }

  function initLocations(key) {
    LOCATIONS.forEach(function (loc) {
      var panel = panels[loc.id];
      panel.mapEl.textContent = "";
      panel.mapEl.style.display = "";

      var geocoder = new google.maps.Geocoder();
      geocoder.geocode({ address: loc.address }, function (results, status) {
        if (status !== "OK" || !results || !results[0]) {
          setPanelStatus(panel, "Geocoding failed (" + status + ") for " + loc.address, true);
          return;
        }
        var locResult = results[0].geometry.location;
        panel.location = { latitude: locResult.lat(), longitude: locResult.lng() };

        panel.map = new google.maps.Map(panel.mapEl, {
          center: { lat: panel.location.latitude, lng: panel.location.longitude },
          zoom: 12
        });
        panel.marker = new google.maps.Marker({
          position: { lat: panel.location.latitude, lng: panel.location.longitude },
          map: panel.map,
          title: loc.label
        });
        panel.dataLayer = new google.maps.Data({ map: panel.map });
        panel.dataLayer.setStyle({
          fillColor: loc.color,
          fillOpacity: 0.28,
          strokeColor: loc.color,
          strokeWeight: 2
        });

        runIsochrone(panel, key);
      });
    });
  }

  function runIsochrone(panel, key) {
    key = key || getApiKey();
    if (!panel.location || !key) return;

    panel.dataLayer.forEach(function (f) { panel.dataLayer.remove(f); });
    setPanelStatus(panel, "Generating isochrone…");

    var body = {
      location: panel.location,
      travelDuration: panel.durationSel.value + "s",
      travelMode: panel.modeSel.value,
      routingPreference: "TRAFFIC_UNAWARE",
      enableSmoothing: true,
      travelDirection: panel.directionSel.value
    };

    fetch("https://isochrones.googleapis.com/v1/isochrones:generate", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Goog-Api-Key": key
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    })
      .then(function (res) {
        return res.json().then(function (data) {
          if (!res.ok) throw data;
          return data;
        });
      })
      .then(function (data) {
        var geoJson = data && data.isochrone && data.isochrone.geoJson;
        if (!geoJson) throw { error: { message: "Unexpected response shape — see console." } };
        console.log("Isochrone response for " + panel.loc.id, data);
        panel.dataLayer.addGeoJson(geoJson);

        var bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
        panel.dataLayer.forEach(function (feature) {
          feature.getGeometry().forEachLatLng(function (ll) { bounds.extend(ll); });
        });
        bounds.extend(panel.marker.getPosition());
        panel.map.fitBounds(bounds);

        var mins = parseInt(panel.durationSel.value, 10) / 60;
        var modeLabel = panel.modeSel.options[panel.modeSel.selectedIndex].text.toLowerCase();
        var dirLabel = panel.directionSel.value === "FROM" ? "reachable from" : "able to reach";
        setPanelStatus(panel, "Area " + dirLabel + " " + panel.loc.label + " within " + mins + " min " + modeLabel + ".");
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        var msg = (err && err.error && err.error.message) || (err && err.message) || "Request failed";
        setPanelStatus(panel, "Isochrones API error: " + msg, true);
        console.error("Isochrone error for " + panel.loc.id, err);
      });
  }

  function init() {
    buildPanels();

    var savedKey = "";
    try { savedKey = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || ""; } catch (e) {}
    if (savedKey) {
      keyInput.value = savedKey;
    }

    keyShow.addEventListener("change", function () {
      keyInput.type = keyShow.checked ? "text" : "password";
    });

    keyLoadBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var key = getApiKey();
      if (!key) {
        setKeyStatus("Enter an API key first.", "error");
        return;
      }
      try { window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, key); } catch (e) {}
      loadGoogleMaps(key);
    });

    keyClearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      try { window.localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch (e) {}
      keyInput.value = "";
      setKeyStatus("Saved key cleared.");
    });

    if (savedKey) {
      loadGoogleMaps(savedKey);
    }
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
```
